# Solaris CET

Solaris CET is a professional engineering and construction firm anchored in Cetățuia, Romania. We specialize in industrial PV installations, general construction, TPO roofing, and facade systems.

## Key Facts (Invariants)
- Supply: 9,000 CET (fixed supply, immutable).
- Chain: TON blockchain.
- Location: Cetățuia, Romania.

## Services
- PV Installation: End-to-end solar solutions for industrial energy independence.
- General Construction: Turnkey engineering projects with high structural integrity.
- Roofing & TPO: Specialized waterproofing and roofing systems.
- Parapets & Facades: Modern facade systems and safety compliance.
